images.prompt: Keeper of Hours — SCENE PLATE for an in-scene register test. An interior: the Keepers' archive hall — a worn grey flagstone floor filling most of the frame, a low stone plinth with stacked ledgers and a brass hour-glass at the upper-left, a dark wooden shelf of scroll-tubes along the far wall at the top edge, a few fallen pages and a coil of rope on the floor, deep shadowed alcoves. Elevated three-quarter camera (projection C, the ARPG camera): the floor is the play surface and occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, the far wall the upper third; NO characters, NO creatures, NO text, NO UI. LANDSCAPE 1536×1024. Register: painted 2D, illustrated, clean material planes, restrained surface texture, no conspicuous brush or pixel grain. Light: single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, deep cool low-value ambient, readable shadows never pure black; no spell glow. Fill the whole canvas; no border, no vignette.

concerns: Followed the task-specific full-scene 1536×1024 instruction, which conflicts with the register card's green background and sprite-sheet requirements.
Generated key light appears warm despite the register card restricting warm light to spells.
Fallen pages contain writing-like marks despite the prompt's NO text constraint.
Exact projection C constants were unavailable within the permitted inputs.
